press_references.value: Online restaurant reservation trading nears closing time in Louisiana

legal_proceedings.description: Louisiana lawmakers passed House Bill 90 to ban third-party restaurant reservation trading platforms like Appointment Trader, Dorsia, and ResX from arranging reservations without explicit contracts with restaurants. The law, expected to be signed by the governor, will impose fines up to $1,000 per trade for violations, directly impacting these companies' business models in Louisiana.

product.name: Dorsia Membership and Reservation Platform
product.description: A subscription-based mobile and online service that lets approved members discover and book participating restaurants, request reservations, and access selected cultural events and experiences.

product.name: Dorsia Restaurant Partner Services
product.description: A business service for restaurants that provides access to Dorsia members, guaranteed minimum-spend reservations, no-show and cancellation controls, diner insights, and marketing support.

product.name: Dorsia Executive Program
product.description: A subscription program that gives organizations and their authorized users access to Dorsia’s reservation and membership platform through named seats and reservation credits.
